title: Example apps still declare internal create/edit forms that #36425 made inert — migrate them to fieldGroups + showOnCreate and drop the advisory allowlist
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed as a `finding` by seat `repo:objectstack#2` from l2-review#4 delta 7086190847 on PR #36543 (#36425, nit N5). Not triaged; not claimed. Waits on #36543.

## What

PR #36543 retires internal create/edit form views: an object's default form and its `OBJECT.create` form are no longer loaded, so New and Edit lay out by `fieldGroups` and field rules. The example apps still declare such forms, and those forms are now inert:

- `examples/app-showcase`: `form` on task, business-unit and project; `form` plus `formViews.create` on contact. `test/author-time-advisories.test.ts` allowlists the 5 resulting `form-view-internal-not-loaded` warnings, with the reason. Removing them was out of scope for #36543. It reaches `seed.test.ts` (which pins the contact form's sections), the `_sections` translation keys, `coverage.ts` (which counts formViewTypes), and three objects that have no `fieldGroups` to take the sections.
- `examples/app-crm`: lead, opportunity and activity declare internal forms. Their comments were corrected in #36543; the definitions were not touched.

An example teaches by being copied. An inert declaration in an example is the pattern an AI writing metadata will reproduce.

## Ask

Move each example's sections into the object's `fieldGroups` (and `showOnCreate: false` where the create form left a field out). Delete the inert forms, update `seed.test.ts`, the translation keys and `coverage.ts`, and empty the allowlist.

Also take the prose beside the view files that still teaches the sparse create override as the working pattern (L2 record 7086880674 on PR #36543, N5): `examples/app-showcase` `contact.object.ts` (its header comment and the object's `description`) and the `_views.create` translation comments.

Exception: keep `showcase_task · form` if #36545 decides that a default form opened by name from a form-type action is not internal. Three actions open it by name: `showcase_log_time`, `showcase_new_task`, and the Overview's Create Task.

## Likely lane

`domain:devx` (examples), via the area that owns #36425 follow-ups.

## Re-check

`grep -n "form-view-internal-not-loaded" examples/app-showcase/test/author-time-advisories.test.ts`: any hit means the allowlist still holds the entries.
